FC Cincinnati host Nashville SC at TQL Stadium in MLS’ Round One, with the series standing at 1-0 after FC Cincinnati won the first game 1-0 away at Nashville SC. A FC Cincinnati win takes them through, while a Nashville SC win levels the series and forces another game.

Current Form - FC Cincinnati

FC Cincinnati finished ninth in the Eastern Conference with 46 points from a 12-win, 10-draw and 12-loss record, scoring 67 goals and conceding 75. Their last play-off game was a 1-0 win away at Nashville SC. Across their last five matches, they have three wins, one draw and one loss, with 1.4 goals scored and 1.0 conceded per match compared with 2.0 and 2.1 respectively across the season.

Current Form - Nashville SC

Nashville SC finished first in the Eastern Conference with 77 points, recording 23 wins, eight draws and three losses while scoring 71 goals and conceding 25. Their last play-off game ended in a 0-1 home loss to FC Cincinnati. The last five matches brought three wins, one draw and one loss, while their scoring average was 1.4 goals per match against 2.0 across the season. Nashville SC have gone unbeaten in their last five away matches.

Head-to-Head Record

Earlier this season, FC Cincinnati beat Nashville SC 1-0, with Nashville SC at home. FC Cincinnati have three wins and two losses in their last five meetings with Nashville SC. Those meetings have averaged 2.6 goals.

Sam Surridge is Nashville SC’s top scorer with 21 goals and one assist in 29 games, ranking third in league scoring. Cristian Espinoza has four goals and 14 assists in 31 games, while Andy Najar has three goals and seven assists in 32 games. Maxwell Woledzi is a doubt with a concussion.
